versions.notes: 0.2.0 preview: any-colour + seasonal themes; cook-mode timers (pause/resume/restart) that ring-and-hold, progress only while a timer runs, All-steps view, resume unfinished cooks; receipts saved to Google Drive folders; Google Form order intake with auto-poll; per-recipe .qcr export/import and a shared Drive Cookbook. Fixes: check-for-updates, scrollable dropdowns that save, custom line prices, new-ingredient Save button, admin-tab lock, wheel-over-textbox, 2nd-account Enterprise grant.

First preview. Rebuild 5: fixed the dialog/order-form crash (Tk attribute clash), opens maximized, fork+spoon icon; round-2 bug scan - sync-thread hardening, no more UI freezes on restore/update/sign-out, safe cross-device autosave, working history receipts.
